global: This is a bowl of spicy ramen from Daiso Shoten, featuring a rich, reddish broth topped with chopped green onions and a whole boiled egg. The white bowl with red characters rests on a wooden table under warm, natural light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain patterns and subtle texture with visible knots and natural wood lines.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red "大里商店" text and geometric pattern along its rim.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is reddish-orange, glossy, and oily, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, white with subtle yellowish edges, smooth surface, oval shape, slightly glossy.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with golden-brown sear and green onion garnish on its surface.
